response.text:
I can’t send the message right now because the Gmail/send web tool is currently unavailable.

Before I send once the tool is available, please confirm all of the following (reply with explicit confirmation, e.g. “Send now”):

1) Recipients: confirm the exact project list address(es) to use (e.g. project-team@example.com).  
2) Message: do you mean the existing prepared draft? If so, give the draft name/subject or paste the final text here.  
3) Subject line (if different from the draft): __________  
4) Attachments: any files to include? If so, list or attach them.  
5) Final send confirmation phrase: please reply “Send now” to authorize sending to the list.

I will not send anything until you provide these details and the explicit “Send now” confirmation.
